items.headline: EBA Report Highlights SupTech's Role in Enhancing AML and CFT Supervision
items.intro: The European Banking Authority (EBA) has released a significant report detailing the potential of supervisory technology (SupTech) to improve the effectiveness of anti-money laundering (AML) and countering the financing of terrorism (CFT) measures across Europe. This report underscores the importance of integrating advanced technological tools into regulato…
items.summary: The EBA's latest report emphasises the transformative potential of SupTech in enhancing the supervision of AML and CFT efforts. By leveraging technology, regulators can streamline processes, improve data analysis, and enhance their ability to detect suspicious activities. This approach not only facilitates more effective oversight but also supports financial institutions in meeting their compliance obligations more efficiently. The report outlines various technological tools that can be employed in the supervisory landscape, including data analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. These tools can significantly reduce the burden on regulators and financial institutions alike, enabling a more proactive stance against financial crime. Furthermore, the EBA's findings align with ongoing legislative efforts, such as the Financial Markets (MiFID and MiFIR Administrative Penalti…
